profile.name: Wasatch 光谱仪交互式命令行外壳
profile.description: 一个非物理的软件命令行工具，用于连接和操作 Wasatch 光谱仪设备。它主要服务于实验调试、交互式测试和数据采集，可执行连接设备、采集光谱、控制激光、管理暗谱、设置插值坐标轴以及平衡采集参数等操作。
profile.description_en: A non-physical command-line software tool for connecting to and operating Wasatch spectrometer devices. It is mainly used for experiment debugging, interactive testing, and data acquisition, including device connection, spectrum capture, laser control, dark-spectrum management, interpolated axis setup, and acquisition balancing.
